normal.text: Blizzard just tweaked the dungeon XP restriction in WoW: Forever. XP nullification now only kicks in when a party member is more than 12 levels above the enemies, saving wide-level-range dungeon runs from getting punished. Fair fix to stop boosting without hurting normal groups, or still too strict? #worldofwarcraft #warcraft #mmo #mmorpg #gaming

normal.name: Flaky
normal.text: Honestly tempted to buy a Nintendo Switch 2. I've been playing loads more Tomodachi Life, I got Switch Online for the save cloud, and the Switch 2 comes with some benefits over the Steam Deck: thinner, not as chunky has a built-in stand that is solid (for games that work better with external controllers) doesn't run Linux (having to update Steam AND Flatpak is annoying. I don't want to tinker to play SNES games portably...) Build quality is also better than Switch 1 but that's a given. Nintendo fixed a lot of the problems w/ the Switch 1 here so. #Nintendo #NintendoSwitch2 #Switch2 #SteamDeck
